number.why: The served HR 0.79 (95% CI 0.66–0.95) matches the primary stroke-or-systemic-embolism comparison of apixaban versus warfarin. The registry confirms the randomized intention-to-treat population and specifies follow-up through the prespecified efficacy cutoff, clarifying the generic 'trial end' label.

quotes.span: The primary outcome was ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke or systemic embolism.

The rate of the primary outcome was 1.27% per year in the apixaban group, as compared with 1.60% per year in the warfarin group (hazard ratio with apixaban, 0.79; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.66 to 0.95; P<0.001 for noninferiority; P=0.01 for superiority).
POPULATION: Intention to treat analysis, randomized participants.

TIME FRAME: "Intended Treatment Period" started on the day of randomization and ended at the efficacy cut-off date (date on which it was expected that the target number of primary efficacy events [448] would have occurred; set to 30-Jan-2011, prior to unblinding).

entry.why: The registry identifies nonvalvular atrial fibrillation and explicitly requires adults with an additional stroke risk factor. The abstract establishes a direct randomized comparison of an oral direct factor Xa inhibitor with warfarin.

quotes.span:
Subjects With Nonvalvular Atrial Fibrillation
ELIGIBILITY: Inclusion Criteria: * Males and females ≥ 18 yrs with atrial fibrillation (AF) and one or more of the following risk factors for stroke:
Apixaban is a novel oral direct factor Xa inhibitor

In this randomized, double-blind trial, we compared apixaban (at a dose of 5 mg twice daily) with warfarin (target international normalized ratio, 2.0 to 3.0) in 18,201 patients with atrial fibrillation and at least one additional risk factor for stroke.
